name: Pot Golem
description: The Winterworks Pot Golem: a giant, muscular, slightly jelly-like amber humanoid (translucent-looking, painted opaque: dark core, bright edges, trapped bubbles, a fossil leaf, a seed and a mosquito) with wobbly jelly blobs and drips, amber crystal growths, stuck-in sherds and huge fists. The `head` bone is the seat of the real decorated pot (drawn by the game); `face` is the potless dumb face. Arm attachments blade, pickaxe and bow are shown only when equipped. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
author: lowpix example
